target_customer: Commercial services companies (such as HVAC and other building services) selling to commercial properties
problem: Sales teams in commercial services lacked data and tools to find properties, decision makers and demand signals.
business_model: B2B SaaS sales and marketing platform for commercial services

founders.name: Charlie Warren
founders.background_notes: Named on Convex and ServiceTitan pages; not on the YC page.

founders.name: Blake Meulmester
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/COO; ServiceTitan says he leads product.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating property and contact data with sales workflow software is standard engineering with data-sourcing difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Vertical data and workflow focus helped, but general sales intelligence vendors could expand; no strong sourced moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: ServiceTitan agreed to acquire Convex in April 2024.

market_need_then: Not documented in sources opened; Convex later reported customers drove about 1.5 billion dollars of incremental growth in 2023 (company-reported).

branding.domain_note: Held convex.com; BuiltWith shows convex.com redirecting to convexbuilt.com in 2021, inferred and unconfirmed. Name is shared with a developer database company and an insurer.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand itself and name collision with other Convex companies.

outcome_analysis: Convex raised about 60 million dollars across a 4 million seed, a 17 million Series A in 2020 and a 39 million Series B in October 2021, according to its own announcement. ServiceTitan announced a definitive agreement to acquire it on 2 April 2024 and Charlie Warren stayed as CEO. Price was not disclosed, so whether investors made money is unknown.
notes: Seed date not stated by the source; date left null. YC page lists only Meulmester; Warren is from company sources. No dated competitor sources near Winter 2019 were found (search returned only 2026 vendor pages), so list empty. Founder prior employers and education not found.
